# Captured text: kernel.org v7.3 (git show v7.3:PATH in the lab's linux clone, read 2026-11-27) for item walleye-modem-mss-image: the Kconfig blocks of the symbols build/walleye-modem.config sets.
# RPMSG_QCOM_SMD and QCOM_AOSS_QMP, which QCOM_Q6V5_MSS lists as 'X || X=n', are =y in the tree's arm64 defconfig (lines 1639 and 1653 of linux-v7.3/arch/arm64/configs/defconfig): so the optional ones stay in.
# ---- drivers/remoteproc/Kconfig, QCOM_Q6V5_MSS
config QCOM_Q6V5_MSS
	tristate "Qualcomm Hexagon V5 self-authenticating modem subsystem support"
	depends on OF && ARCH_QCOM
	depends on QCOM_SMEM
	depends on RPMSG_QCOM_SMD || RPMSG_QCOM_SMD=n
	depends on RPMSG_QCOM_GLINK_SMEM || RPMSG_QCOM_GLINK_SMEM=n
	depends on QCOM_SYSMON || QCOM_SYSMON=n
	depends on RPMSG_QCOM_GLINK || RPMSG_QCOM_GLINK=n
	depends on QCOM_AOSS_QMP || QCOM_AOSS_QMP=n
	select MFD_SYSCON
	select QCOM_MDT_LOADER
	select QCOM_PIL_INFO
	select QCOM_Q6V5_COMMON
	select QCOM_RPROC_COMMON
	select QCOM_SCM
	select QCOM_PAS
# ---- drivers/soc/qcom/Kconfig, QCOM_RMTFS_MEM
config QCOM_RMTFS_MEM
	tristate "Qualcomm Remote Filesystem memory driver"
	select QCOM_SCM
	default m if ARCH_QCOM
	help
